context_schema.name: fragment_file
context_schema.desc: 3D molecule file containing at least two disconnected fragments; required only for the DiffLinker route.

context_schema.name: complex_mmcif_file
context_schema.desc: Optional untouched source complex mmCIF for prep-only mode and Arpeggio supplemental interaction analysis.

context_schema.name: chain
context_schema.desc: Explicit target author chain; resolve entity/assembly first, never assume A.

context_schema.name: docking_memory_mode
context_schema.desc: Agent-side docking planning mode; default ligand_protein. off uses no docking memory, legacy recalls protein neighbors, ligand_only disables protein reweighting. The runner never queries memory or changes explicit tool selections.

context_schema.name: candidate_source
context_schema.desc: Explicit molecule provenance for automatic V1/V2/V3 selection. Use sampled_library when an externally supplied large library was sampled before injection; omit only when artifact provenance is sufficient to derive the source.

context_schema.name: known_site_provenance
context_schema.desc: Optional provenance for known_site_residues: source, method, independent_of_reference_structure and review_status.

context_schema.name: known_required_interactions
context_schema.desc: Approved curated hard constraints. Each item requires residue, interaction_type, rationale, source, binding_mode_scope and review_status='approved'; atom/features and logic groups are optional.

context_schema.name: scientific_facts
context_schema.desc: Declared chemistry facts passed to capability checks and tools. They never enable, disable, or select tools.

scientific_facts_schema.name: has_metal
scientific_facts_schema.desc: Metal or metallocofactor participates in the binding site.

scientific_facts_schema.name: is_covalent
scientific_facts_schema.desc: The requested chemistry uses a covalent mechanism.

scientific_facts_schema.name: protonation_sensitive
scientific_facts_schema.desc: Binding depends on uncertain ionization or tautomer states.

project_schema.name: campaign_state_file
project_schema.desc: Durable R1-R3 campaign authorization and execution budget.

project_schema.name: campaign_stage
project_schema.desc: Scientific stage; independent of round_number and retry attempts.

project_schema.name: campaign_attempt
project_schema.desc: Attempt within the scientific stage; checkpoint resumes reuse the same attempt.

project_schema.name: round_decision_file
project_schema.desc: Agent-authored plan bound to this config; required for campaign execution.

project_schema.name: upstream_project_dir
project_schema.desc: Prior round dir to reuse artifacts from

project_schema.name: execution_mode
project_schema.desc: Agent orchestration mode. 'interrupt' checkpoints after every newly processed step so the Agent can request explicit user confirmation; 'auto' runs all remaining steps. The initial steps/tools plan still requires confirmation in both modes.

project_schema.name: resume_existing
project_schema.desc: Reuse a successful step result only when its resolved input/tool/runtime and local-file fingerprint matches; PocketMiner-enabled Step 1 always reruns. This controls ordinary cache reuse for a pending step, not the separately validated processed-step prefix in an interactive checkpoint.

runtime_resources_schema.name: lock_directory
runtime_resources_schema.desc: Shared absolute lock directory; defaults to data_root/_resources

strategy_params.name: site_selection_strategy
strategy_params.desc: Explicit pocket-selection algorithm chosen by the Agent. Execution never infers this value from ligand availability. provided_box characterizes the supplied docking_box without replacing it. detector_consensus uses plan-pocket-tools to select native Top-3 detectors, using protein memory when available and fixed DeepPocket#1 rank fusion only when memory is unavailable or explicitly disabled.

strategy_params.name: search_space_source
strategy_params.desc: Explicit docking search-space source. The runner never chooses between a reference-ligand autobox and an explicit box.

rules.description: Fallback within one target/protocol: <=-7 pass; -7 to -1 flag; >-1 fail. Cohort normalization remains the primary ranking treatment.
Vina-like fallback within one scoring function/protocol: <=-7 pass; -7 to -1 flag; >-1 fail.
GNINA Vina-like minimized affinity fallback: <=-7 pass; -7 to -1 flag; >-1 fail; it is not CNNaffinity.

No universal absolute cutoff: finite confidence values are ranked only within one receptor/model/checkpoint/protocol cohort. This runtime-only signal is audit-only because the canonical catalog does not assign it a child weight.

No universal absolute cutoff: finite native grid scores are ranked lower-is-better only within one sphere/grid/scoring-protocol cohort. It is audit-only because the canonical catalog has no DOCK 6 row.
Fallback within one grid/preparation/protocol cohort: <=-7 pass; -7 to -1 flag; >-1 fail. It is an estimated docking energy, not experimental binding free energy.
No Vina-like absolute cutoff: rank lower-is-better only within one rDock scoring function, cavity, restraint, and parameter protocol.

AutoDockFR bounds: <=-6 pass; -6 to 0 flag; >0 fail, ranked lower-is-better within one protocol cohort. A flexible-receptor protocol requires a fixed flexible-residue set, while the registered runtime ADFR is rigid-receptor, so treat the value as a same-protocol rank and a coarse sanity bound rather than a flexible-receptor result.
Native score is -affinity/HAC; multiply by -1 for the numeric table's affinity/HAC convention: <=-0.25 pass, >-0.05 fail.

Intermolecular term of vina_affinity in kcal/mol. It is a sub-term of an already-weighted total, so it never adds score; a positive value is physically implausible for a bound pose and fails this metric so the pose can be screened out.

Intramolecular energy of the best pose in kcal/mol, i.e. the quality ceiling this ligand can reach. Score-excluded; a positive value fails so a strained best pose is caught instead of being silently accepted.
One-based rank inside one ligand-preparation run; ranks above 20 hard-fail the pose export set, are demoted to a flag for the parent molecule, and never add score.
score_2-score_1 within one preparation: >=0.5 pass; <0.5 flags as uncertain only, with no hard molecular failure.

>=0.50 pass; 0.20-0.50 flag; <0.20 fail. The value is a pose-quality score, not a calibrated probability.

validation_rules.selection_matrix: before validation, every registered step and tool must have an explicit enabled boolean; registry defaults never complete a missing selection
validation_rules.preparation_phases: structure_prep is geometry-only (PDBFixer add_hydrogens=false; missing residues opt-in); PROPKA is diagnostic and Reduce provisional. Final protonation, waters and PDBQT belong to mandatory docking.docking_prep after prefilter; explicit chain, backend, pH when applicable, water policy and ligand-state justification are required.
validation_rules.VR1: every tool id under a step must exist in that step's registry
validation_rules.VR2: every param/context/project key must exist in its schema
validation_rules.VR3: param type / min-max / choices (including list item choices) must hold; configurable metric soft bounds must not exceed their hard bounds
validation_rules.VR4: an enabled step/tool's required artifact must be produced by an enabled upstream step, preloaded from upstream_project_dir, or supplied via input_artifacts
validation_rules.VR5: same-step tool dependencies and tool-one-of requirements must hold
validation_rules.VR6: every at-least-one tool class must retain an enabled member
validation_rules.VR7: tool context prerequisites must be present
validation_rules.VR8: exactly one tool must be enabled in each mutually-exclusive class
validation_rules.VR9: an explicitly enabled tool may not remain under a parent step disabled by explicit config; range-excluded upstream settings may remain for lineage
validation_rules.VR10: enabled MM-GBSA requires pose_evaluation plus a built, sufficiently large candidate-topology cohort
validation_rules.top_level: unknown top-level keys hard-fail; input_artifacts must be injectable file paths and may not collide with an enabled producer
validation_rules.explicit_modes: pocket site-selection and docking search-space modes must be explicit, compatible with the selected tools, and backed by required artifacts
validation_rules.capability: unsupported covalent docking, generic Amber topology for declared metal sites, and tools missing explicitly supplied artifacts hard-fail
validation_rules.evaluation: pose identity, generated-3D QC, short-MD, MM-GBSA, and RBFE escalation contracts must remain complete; first_passing_per_compound cannot be combined with mdanalysis or mmgbsa because they revise verdicts after selection
validation_rules.metric_gates: configurable soft/hard metric thresholds must preserve pass/flag/fail marking order
